title: Fly-Hi Maritime Travels IPO Details
intro:
Fly-Hi Maritime IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹52.63 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 41.60 lakh shares aggregating to ₹42.44 crores and offer for sale of 10.00 lakh shares aggregating to ₹10.20 crores.

Fly-Hi Maritime IPO opens for subscription on Sep 1, 2026 and closes on Sep 3, 2026. The allotment for the Fly-Hi Maritime IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 4, 2026. Fly-Hi Maritime IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 8, 2026.

Fly-Hi Maritime IPO is set final issue price at ₹102 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,44,800 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,67,200.

Corporate Makers Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Bhaijee Broking & Investments Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Fly-Hi Maritime IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in September 2021, Fly-Hi Maritime Travels Limited is a specialized maritime travel company engaged in providing end-to-end crew travel and mobility solutions for commercial shipping companies. The Company manages travel arrangements for seafarers from their home countries to their designated ports of boarding, including airline ticketing, route planning, ground transportation, hotel bookings, visa coordination and 24/7 travel support.

The Company offers customized travel solutions designed around vessel schedules, crew joining windows and the requirements of multinational shipping crews. Its services include global crew ticketing, visa and immigration coordination, OK-to-board confirmations, real-time travel monitoring, disruption handling, emergency support and boarding confirmation. The Company operates through a centralized operational model, with its operations managed from its Mumbai corporate office, while also having a distributor in the UAE to support certain international customers.

Fly-Hi Maritime Travels serves commercial shipping companies across more than six countries, including Cyprus, Greece, the USA, the UK, Singapore, UAE and India. The Company is an International Air Transport Association (IATA) accredited company and its registered office has been recognized as a startup by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
As of July 31, 2026, the Company had a workforce of 54 employees across travel operations, marketing and sales, visa operations, finance, IT, HR and other support functions.

faqs.question: How to apply in Fly-Hi Maritime IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Fly-Hi Maritime IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Fly-Hi Maritime IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Fly-Hi Maritime IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Fly-Hi Maritime IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Fly-Hi Maritime IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Fly-Hi Maritime IPO opens on Tue, Sep 1, 2026 and closes on Thu, Sep 3, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Fly-Hi Maritime IPO?
faqs.answer: Fly-Hi Maritime IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,44,800 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Fly-Hi Maritime IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Fly-Hi Maritime IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Fly-Hi Maritime IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Fly-Hi Maritime IPO will be done on Friday, September 4, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 7, 2026 . Check the Fly-Hi Maritime IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Fly-Hi Maritime IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Fly-Hi Maritime IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 8, 2026 .
